profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Housecall Pro
profile.summary:
Born and raised in East LA, I began my college journey at Mt. San Antonio College before transferring to the University of California, Irvine, where I earned my bachelor’s degree in Computer Science. I’ve been interested in computers and technology for as long as I can remember, so pursuing software engineering felt like a natural path.

Today, I’m a Staff Software Engineer at Housecall Pro, where I work on systems and products that help our teams better serve and support Service Professionals. My experience spans full-stack and backend development, distributed systems, integrations, data infrastructure, and, more recently, AI-powered products and tooling.

One of the things I enjoy most about software engineering is collaboration. I genuinely enjoy helping others work through problems, whether that means brainstorming a solution, debugging an issue, or sharing something I’ve learned. I’ve found that teaching and collaborating not only helps the team, but also strengthens my own understanding.I’m also naturally curious and enjoy learning about new technologies, architectures, and ways of building software. Technology is constantly evolving, and that’s one of the things that keeps me excited about the field.

Some technologies I’ve worked with include Ruby on Rails, React, Go, Java, C++, C, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, Docker, Kafka, AWS, and AI/LLM tooling including APIs and MCP-based integrations.

At the end of the day, I enjoy building useful things, solving challenging problems, and working with people who are excited about creating great software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Consultant for Pacific Life.
- Deployed key upgrades to enterprise applications using CD methodology for production and staging environments.
- Created new and maintained current automated UI testing scripts via python selenium to ensure healthiness of a production web application and identify issues before reaching the users.
- Created python scripts to automate processes for the internal team to streamline re-occurring tasks.
- Provided support to App Dev teams for P1 and P2 incidents.
- Managed and support staging/production RHE Linux and Window Enterprise servers.
- Managed and continuously update team SOP knowledge base when needed.

positions.title: Student Assistant III
positions.description: Provided tutoring services to students enrolled in the Accessibility Resource Centers for Students (ACCESS) and Veterans Program for subjects such as Computer Science, Math, and English.

projects.title: FabFlix
projects.description:
Movie Catalog Web Application

- Developed backend microservices (Identity Mangement, Movie Data, and PayPal checkout / Transaction) using Java.
- Connected all the microservices through a API gateway which communicates to the users.
- Designed frontend using React JavaScript Library.
- Created RESTful web services utilizing Grizzly server, Jersey Java framework, and JSON data to tie the whole application together.
